categories.main_business_segments: DeepGlint focuses on AI-driven cognitive intelligence products and solutions integrating computer vision, multimodal large models, big data analytics, and robotics. Its primary application domains include smart finance, urban management, smart education, industrial inspection, and special fields through hardware terminal computing devices. The company also develops AI PCs and intelligent hardware for specialized sectors via its subsidiary Guoke Yidao.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include multimodal large models, 3D stereo vision, automated traffic scene perception and event recognition, large-scale cross-camera tracking, robotic perception and control, and video action analysis. It operates a proprietary AI platform called DeepGlint Brain, which supports data collection, annotation, model training, and optimization. Manufacturing is outsourced, with hardware production supported by its subsidiary and contract manufacturers, ensuring quality control and stable production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are financial institutions (notably China Agricultural Bank with nationwide coverage), government agencies (public security, urban management), educational institutions (smart campus sports and physical fitness testing), industrial clients (rail transit inspection), and special sectors requiring secure and ruggedized computing devices. The company serves primarily domestic Chinese markets with expanding applications in smart finance, urban governance, education, industrial inspection, and special fields.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated in China, covering multiple provinces and cities including Beijing, Hebei, and others. The company’s products and solutions are deployed nationwide in banking branches, government departments, educational institutions, and industrial sites. There is no significant overseas revenue reported, and international expansion is limited due to geopolitical and trade restrictions.
categories.supply_chain_position: DeepGlint operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI supply chain, focusing on AI algorithm development, software platforms, and integrated AI solutions. Through its subsidiary Guoke Yidao, it also engages in upstream hardware design and terminal device manufacturing, enabling soft-hard integration for specialized applications. The company outsources hardware production to contract manufacturers but controls product design and software adaptation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in multimodal large models and AI foundational technologies, investing heavily in developing proprietary models and algorithms. It pursues innovation in AI applications across verticals like smart finance, urban management, education, and industrial inspection. Strategic initiatives include domestic adaptation of AI products, integration of AI with hardware terminals, and expansion into special fields. The company also emphasizes talent development, organizational restructuring, and commercialization of AI technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of AI products and solutions, including software platforms, AI models, and integrated hardware-software systems. The company offers both standardized products and customized solutions tailored to client needs. It also earns income from hardware sales via its subsidiary, and provides ongoing technical services. Revenue recognition follows delivery and acceptance milestones, with some SaaS software revenue recognized over time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DeepGlint positions itself as a leading AI company in computer vision and multimodal AI in China, with strong academic and industry recognition. It competes with other AI firms focusing on vertical applications in finance, urban management, education, and industrial inspection. Its competitive advantages include proprietary large models, extensive data resources, and integrated hardware capabilities. The company faces risks from rapid technological changes and intense competition in AI and hardware sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 117 million, a 55% decline from the previous year, primarily due to delayed product deliveries in smart finance. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 212 million, with increased R&D expenses accounting for over 160% of revenue. Total assets were around RMB 2.3 billion, with a slight decrease year-over-year. The company is in a growth and investment phase, focusing on technology development and market expansion despite short-term financial losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DeepGlint emphasizes advanced AI capabilities, particularly in multimodal large models and computer vision, delivering high-accuracy, scalable AI solutions tailored to complex industry scenarios. Its unique value lies in integrating cutting-edge AI algorithms with domestically produced hardware for secure, reliable applications in finance, public security, education, and industrial sectors. The company’s proprietary AI platform and extensive data assets enable rapid model training and deployment, providing clients with efficient, customizable, and innovative AI-driven products.
